name: Opal Palace
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity. If you spend this mana to cast your commander, it enters with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity. If you spend this mana to cast your commander, it enters with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.

needs.what: a mana-ability rider (beside mana_grant / mana_spent_trigger) that, when this ability's mana is spent on a spell matching a filter (here is_commander), stages on that spell an 'enters with N additional +1/+1 counters' replacement for the permanent it becomes, with N a value read at spend time (command_zone_casts_of the spell, i.e. commander_casts_this_game for that commander)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_grant carries only keywords to the resulting permanent, never counters; mana_spent_trigger is a triggered ability that resolves while the spell is still on the stack, so an add_counters on its subject would put counters on the spell, not make the permanent enter with them; enters_with_additional_counters / self_enters_with_counters are standing replacements on the entering card itself, not one-shots handed to a spell by the mana that paid for it. The add_mana half (in_commander_identity) and the count (command_zone_casts_of) both exist
